## Resource

- **Name:**
- **URL:** (official docs, repository or product page)
- **Section it belongs in:** (AI Builders Start Here / Identity & Authentication / Payments / Maps & Location / Address & Postcode / Messaging & Channels / AI / LLM for Korean / MCP Servers / Public & Government Data / Commerce & Logistics / Startup Support & Funding / Compliance Gotchas / Related lists)

## Signals

- 🌐 **Docs:** (EN / KO / EN~)
- 🔑 **Auth:** (key / oauth / cert / none)
- 🛂 **Access from abroad:** (✅ / ⚠️ / ❌, with a short reason)
- 💰 **Cost:** (free / freemium / paid)
- 🤖 **AI:** (MCP / SDK / REST)

## How you verified the 🛂 rating

Official docs you read, or a real signup attempt from outside Korea. If you could not confirm it, say so and we will mark it ⚠️ unverified.

## Checklist

- [ ] A builder can plug it in (API, SDK, MCP server, platform service or program), not a marketing page.
- [ ] It is specific to building for Korea, not a general global tool.
- [ ] It is currently maintained (updated within the last 18 months).
- [ ] I'm not affiliated with the resource, or I've disclosed the affiliation above.
